about: Licence facts for bundled npm packages whose published archive leaves one out, reviewed by hand. The web build (scripts/thirdPartyNotices.mjs) reads a record only for what the installed package does not ship itself, and fails when a bundled package has neither, when a record supplies something the package already ships, and when a record matches no bundled package. Records are keyed by name@version, so an upgrade fails until its record is reviewed again.
